title: E-invoice transmitter profile
description: The remote call shape of a fiscalisation authority, as DATA (ADR 0052). This schema names no authority's endpoint, field or version; a profile FILE does, and its `source` says which document those values came from (ADR 0051 for a real one).

code.description: The transmitter code. Closed vocabulary, matching app.company.einvoice_transmitter and app.einvoice_transmission.transmitter.

version.description: The profile file's own version. Recorded on every transmission as profile_version (LEGACY-013).

source.description: Where these values came from. For a real profile this cites the ADR that recorded the authority's own current documentation. scripts/check/no-authority-literals.sh fails the build when a myinvois profile does not cite 0051.

baseUrl.description: Scheme, host and optional port. No path, no query: a path belongs to a call spec.

timeoutMs.description: The one deadline of a remote call: the token fetch, the request and its single 401 retry share it (packages/db/src/einvoice/http-transmitter.ts). At most HALF of CLAIM_WINDOW_SECONDS (120 s, packages/db/src/einvoice/transmission.ts), after which another caller may take the transmission's claim over and call the authority again; packages/db/test/einvoice/profile.test.ts pins the relation.

kind.description: Direct bearer token, preserved for existing profiles.

pathTemplate.description: A rooted path with {externalId} as the only permitted placeholder. It cannot carry a scheme or a host, so a profile cannot redirect one call away from baseUrl.

statusMap.description: The authority's own status labels, mapped onto §4.9.3's six. A label absent from this map becomes 'error' with the raw label recorded in last_error — never a silent 'accepted'.

allOf.description: A call that names a remote object must be able to interpolate its id.

The submit call — the one that sends the document — MUST name where the authority's id comes back, because `einvoice_transmission_external_id_check` (migration 0057) refuses status submitted/accepted/cancelled with a null external_id. Without this clause a profile that omits externalIdPointer validates, submitTransmission sets the status the statusMap yields, and a raw SQLSTATE 23514 escapes a worker job as an unmapped database error instead of an EInvoiceError. `required: ["body"]` is deliberate: `body` defaults to "none", so a call that omits it is not the submit call and this clause must not fire on it.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer with at least one reference token.
